snippet.title: Milo's Magical Adventure Trailer
snippet.description:
Milo, a plucky young dragon, has a problem: their mom has gone missing! Take off on a quest to find out what happened to her, as you navigate the terrain of an enchanted world. Scamper through forests and villages, using your wits to avoid the many hazards of the realm.

Free to download and play on iOS and Android:

--- Apple App Store: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/milos-magical-adventure/id6450372744
--- Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.MassDiGI.TeamCornDog

MassDigi SIP23 - Milo's Magical Adventure game
